description: Persistent HELD SURFACE reconstruction (seed block 180000). The surface-level twin of the per-receptor adapting floor: a first-class HeldSurfaceCell per retina cell whose `value` EMA-accumulates the eye's per-tick observed surface luminance (the cell's rod `caught_quanta`, which carries photon shot noise). The blend `value' = value + lr*(observed - value)` is a graph RULE over standard DSL Terms firing under run_rules(); it BUILDS a fixed scene (converges toward the true surface, temporally denoising the noisy single-tick observation) and it FORGETS (the same EMA decays stale content toward changed content -> object-permanence-WITH-forgetting). OFF by default: `held_surface_accumulate` cannot fire unless a HeldSurfaceParams node exists AND is enabled (created by the measure adapter only when the world opts in); absent it every existing path is byte-identical. The observed drive is read live off the rod (`rod_receptor`), fresh-guarded so the blend only fires after this epoch's transduction has updated caught_quanta. Unlike the adapting floor (a fast internal gain reference the transduction owns), this is a persistent held BELIEF about the scene surface, rendered as the surface reconstruction with honest holes.
